en.title: Inspect classic 5.3 projects and rebuild editable conversions
en.body: Review script order, missing assets, theme declarations and host dependencies before conversion. Rebuild an edited conversion against its recorded engine and project ID, then compare changed inputs and gameplay.

zh.title: 盘点白鹭 5.3 工程并重建可编辑的迁移结果
zh.body: 转换前核对脚本顺序、缺失资源、主题声明及宿主依赖。修改迁移工程后使用已记录的引擎和工程标识重建，再对照输入差异与玩法。
